## Activity

During March 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 378 captures. The activity recorded for the month provides a summary of the volume handled by the clinic and the subsequent review of image quality and grading outcomes. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational issues are noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Of the 378 captures, 13 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.4. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for review, while a smaller proportion could not be graded. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring causes can be identified and addressed where appropriate.

## Grading

A total of 85 results were referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 17. This provides the main measure of grading timeliness for March 2022. Taken together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide a concise operational overview for West Gate Eye Clinic during the month.
